appearances.whereabouts: Baerlon, at the Stag and Lion inn and exploring the city streets
appearances.notable_actions: Wakes late from troubled dreams; learns about dead rats with broken backs from the cook; encounters Min who tells him about visions she sees around people; explores Baerlon; meets Padan Fain who runs away; confronts three Whitecloaks after Mat's prank; experiences strange sensations of heat and tingling; discusses the shared dream with Mat, Perrin and Thom
appearances.demeanor: Increasingly detached and fevered, experiencing strange sensations and difficulty concentrating; feels packed with wool, disconnected; has moments of irrational confidence when confronting the Whitecloaks

appearances.whereabouts: The kitchen of the Stag and Lion

appearances.demeanor: Nervous, conciliatory, afraid of losing his cook

appearances.demeanor: Assertive, protective, talkative, cheerful with Rand after confrontation

appearances.whereabouts: The Stag and Lion inn
appearances.notable_actions: Killed over a dozen rats, all with broken backs, and unusually left the bodies where they fell

appearances.whereabouts: The kitchen of the Stag and Lion

appearances.whereabouts: Common room of the Stag and Lion performing, then city streets with Rand and Mat
appearances.notable_actions: Performs storytelling about the Great Hunt of the Horn; listens to Rand and Mat's account of their shared dream; advises them urgently not to speak Ba'alzamon's name in public; tells them about the dangerous historical names mentioned in the dream; advises them not to tell Moiraine yet; rushes back to the inn to warn Perrin
appearances.demeanor: Theatrical while performing, then serious and protective when discussing the dreams; watchful and concerned

appearances.whereabouts: The Stag and Lion, in his room then meeting the others outside
